title: Searchable library
detail: A Skillager-style library uses labeled search, a keyboard-navigable list, and a readable detail view. Host access remains separately approved.

title: Small clock
detail: A small clock can use the same typography and theme tokens. A local timer changes guest content without host access or a build step.

title: Document details
detail: Select a row with the mouse or Arrow keys. Home and End reach the first and last result. No results leaves a useful message and keeps search available.
